samples.scenario: A widely used Python package was targeted when attackers gained access to the package's PyPI account and published a new release containing a malicious post-install hook. This hook executed a stealthy reverse shell connection to a remote attacker-controlled server, allowing persistent access to all downstream users who updated the package.

This library loaded during application startup and performed credential harvesting by hooking into system keyring APIs, then exfiltrated data via encrypted HTTPS to a C2 server.
